issues.summary: Pacific Meridian voy 019N carrying container PSSU5173790 (HBL MFCIM260003 / MBL PSSU260111) delayed 6 days due to Shanghai port congestion, ETA Busan moved from 2026-01-28 to 2026-02-03, escalated as Severity 1.
Daehan Precision requested priority customs clearance for container PSSU5173790 upon arrival as the sensors are needed for production; release obtained 2026-02-04.

decisions.summary: Minseo Park decided to accept the 6-day delay without re-routing the cargo and to send Daehan Precision daily ETA updates until arrival in Busan.

tasks.summary: Send Daehan Precision a daily ETA update for container PSSU5173790 until the vessel arrives in Busan.
Arrange priority customs clearance for HBL MFCIM260003 (container PSSU5173790) as soon as it arrives in Busan.
